# Draft:Billy Edward Hastings

----
Lord Billy Edward Hastings was born in Kent. Lord Hastings has worked for the NHS since 2015.
Early Life
Lord Billy Edward Hastings was born in Chatham, Kent on Sunday 4th April 1993.
Family
Lord Hastings family derives from the Plantagenets. The Plantagenets were a powerful English royal dynasty that ruled from 1154 to 1485, originating from Geoffrey Plantagenet, Count of Anjou, whose nickname derived from the Latin for "yellow broom" (planta genista), a sprig of which he reportedly wore as an emblem. This dynasty, also known as the Angevin dynasty, oversaw England's transformation, developing Parliament, legal systems, and English culture (Chaucer) but ended in civil strife, culminating in the War of the Roses, a feud between its Lancastrian and Yorkist branches, with Richard III being the last Plantagenet king. Lord Hastings is also a decedent of Henry Hastings, 3rd Earl of Huntingdon
Lord Hastings is also related to Lady Flora Hastings
Lady Flora Elizabeth Rawdon-Hastings (11 February 1806 – 5 July 1839) was a British aristocrat and lady-in-waiting to Queen Victoria's mother, the Duchess of Kent.[1] Her death in 1839 was the subject of a court scandal that gave the Queen a negative image.
